goal: Create a new custom tool `youtube_transcript_formatted` that saves YouTube transcripts using the user's preferred naming convention: `YYYY-MM-DD_Title-transcription.txt`.
notes: The existing `youtube_transcript` tool saves files in a different format.
The goal is to achieve consistency with audio transcription filenames.
I will implement this by creating a new tool that fetches metadata and transcript directly.

tasks.title: Research the existing youtube_transcript tool implementation (if possible) or identify necessary libraries for metadata and transcripts.
